Open Source Intel Polish territory is no longer under aerial threat. A new alert went out to residents in the Lubelskie and Podkarpackie regions confirming the all clear. Poland's RCB Air raid sirens sounded in Lublin, Poland, amid reports that a Russian cruise missile may have entered Polish airspace. Contributed by @AZ_Intel_. https://x.com/MichalMC1/status/2123652914921300147/video/1 - Open Source Intel tweet

OSINTdefender During tonight’s air raid alert in Eastern Poland, resulting from the intrusion of a possible Russian cruise missile into Polish Airspace, the air traffic control tower was evacuated from the first time at Rzeszów-Jasionka Airport. Nine people, including six operational staff, were ordered to a temporary shelter at Rzeszów. W związku z dzisiejszym zagrożeniem atakiem z powietrza dla przestrzeni powietrznej RP, władze @PANSA_PL po raz pierwszy pojęły decyzję o ewakuacji wieży kontroli lotów w Porcie Lotniczym Rzeszów-Jasionka. 9 osob w tym 6 osob personelu operacyjnego przebywało w doraźnym miejscu schronienia. Dotychczas tego typu ewakuacje miały miały miejsce dwukrotnie dla pracowników wieży TWR Lublin. - Dariusz Klimczak tweet

OSINTdefender RT @andrii_sybiha : Another violation of Polish (and NATO) airspace as a result of the massive Russian attack on Ukraine demonstrates the threats posed by Russian aggression to the whole of Europe and the transatlantic community. While Moscow tries to initiate discussions about the “new security architecture of Europe,” Russian missiles and drones directly undermine the existing security order in Europe. The first step toward strengthening it would probably be to cease such attacks. Ukraine holds the first line of defense against the Russian threat. By supporting Ukraine’s capabilities, allies are protecting their own people and their security. Now it is critical to ramp up pressure on Russia, strengthen Ukraine’s air defense, and advance peace efforts. We stand in solidarity with Poland and the Polish people. We are working closely together to provide all necessary assistance in investigating this incident and preventing such threats in the future. tweet
